description: This PHP class file defines the EmpEmergencyContactModel, which is part of the OrangeHRM project. It models the emergency contact information for employees, including properties such as ID, name, relationship, and various phone numbers. The class implements a serializer interface and uses traits for common serialization behavior. It is likely used to expose or handle emergency contact data within the HR management API.
